- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive story pet stage preview: Redesign the story intro screen into a stage layout featuring animated previews of interactive pets before selecting a path. (why: Mean time on choose_path is 514 seconds; setting pet expectations visually early reduces hesitation.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive desktop control guide screen: Insert a dedicated tutorial screen after home_intro demonstrating how to summon, minimize, and control the desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple tickets about users being confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
2: [home, redesign] Spotlight desktop positioning preview waiting screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight layout demonstrating where and how the pet will spawn on the user's screen. (why: Home step median time is 201s and support noted users reporting pets failing to display on desktop.)
3: [finish, layout] Full bleed mascot welcome hero: Change home_intro layout to full_bleed spotlight with a clear badge indicating how to access pet settings. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% with mean time of 5815s, indicating lack of clarity on completed setup.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop engine initialization status text: Display a structured progress bar and detailed step descriptions on the waiting screen. (why: Home target step mean duration is 2336s; clear feedback reassures users that loading has not stalled.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path decision comparison summary hint: Add a decision aid hint directly explaining the difference between premade and photo-generated pets. (why: Choose path step mean duration is 514s, indicating confusion when choosing a pet creation mode.)
